attacks.claim: The rollback re-enables MailPoet sending but only re-imports new Ghost signups. Unsubscribes, bounces and complaints recorded in Ghost after cutover are not synced back, so a rollback could re-mail opted-out readers, and a sent email cannot be recalled. Mail sent from Ghost before a rollback also has no duplicate-send guard.
attacks.evidence: rollback = repoint DNS and re-enable MailPoet sending, with any new Ghost signups exported and re-imported to MailPoet.

attacks.claim: Send-day outages are the stated core problem, yet the plan has no monitoring or alerting for Ghost, MySQL, Mailgun webhooks or backups. It has no mid-send failure runbook or on-call owner for the split send, and no load or send rehearsal on the new single VPS. The only success measure is 'zero outages', with no way to detect failures.
attacks.evidence: Zero send-day outages over the first quarter. ABSENT: monitoring/alerting, mid-send failure runbook, load test on the new VPS

attacks.claim: Restoring a nightly dump, or loading the weekly export into another sender, could silently bring back addresses unsubscribed or erased after that snapshot. There is no suppression-preserving restore step. The plan also does not say how subscribers with no recorded consent source are imported.
attacks.evidence: nightly encrypted dumps to object storage (30-day retention) ... consent source/IP where recorded. ABSENT: restore procedure that re-applies suppressions; handling of records with no consent

attacks.claim: The suppression reconciliation compares counts only. It does not verify that each unsubscribed or bounced address is actually non-mailable in Ghost.
attacks.evidence: counts reconciled against MailPoet totals (active / unsubscribed / bounced / paid)

attacks.claim: The 37 mismatched paid members are resolved by hand with no owner, verification step, or defined outcome for any member left unresolved at cutover.
attacks.evidence: 37 members with mismatched emails ... will be resolved by hand before cutover.

attacks.claim: The plan does not specify admin access, 2FA, firewall policy, secrets handling or key custody for the backup encryption and member-list exports. The system holds 46k emails and Stripe-linked data.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: admin roles, 2FA, secrets storage, backup key management

attacks.claim: There is no privacy notice update or DPA review for the new processors (Mailgun, object storage). Erasure requests are not carried through to the old VPS copy or the backups.
attacks.evidence: Mailgun only receives per-send recipient batches. ABSENT: privacy notice update, DPA, deletion process for old VPS and backups
